text:
Type: black two-drawer chest
Use: bedside storage for small items, top for a lamp; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: black lacquered wood and fiberboard, antique brass bar handles
Colors: deep black, warm antique brass
Shape: compact squarish chest with two deep drawers, a single brass bar pull on each, framed fronts with raised edges, overhanging molded top, heavy molded plinth base, solid and stately
Feel: elegant, formal, rich, dramatic
Goes with: dark or crisp white walls, velvet, brass and marble accents; classic or traditional bedrooms

product.name: UNDREDAL
product.description: Integrated damper catches the running drawer and closes it slowly, silently and softly.
